perform atomic specialist work

write Product or consumer state

blocks.atomic_scope_statement: Control-plane governance for bootstrap and project-initializer context discovery only; it does not implement Product work, create provider identity, authorize adoption, or accept itself.

authorize project adoption or provider identity creation
create, rotate, or handle credentials or secrets
direct protected Memory internals
infer missing authority, jurisdiction, entity, activity, data class, version, or effective date
publish, deploy, migrate, or write Product

compose only with the declared portable bootstrap contract
preserve exact discovery provenance and custody identity
split_required_when: tool, browser, build, or deploy custody differs

blocks.atomic_scope_statement: Control-plane evidence review for one named candidate digest and its declared evaluation contract; it does not author the candidate or decide Product, legal, regulatory, financial, safety, or deployment outcomes.
permitted_decisions: classify exact candidate evidence as sufficient, insufficient, conflicting, or not applicable
issue an independent evaluation receipt for the inspected candidate digest
record unknowns, residuals, and dependent-action closure

forbidden_decisions: activate, admit, merge, publish, deploy, migrate, or release a candidate
author, repair, rewrite, or delete the candidate or Product state
claim legal, regulatory, accounting, safety, or professional certification
infer missing jurisdiction, entity, activity, data class, version, effective date, or applicability
override source, custody, authority, or independent-reviewer conflicts
self-accept, self-admit, or treat its own receipt as admission authority
composition_rules: UNKNOWN closes only the dependent evaluation or admission action
a domain-specific claim requires its own named authority and source lock
compose with the evaluation/admission gate only through a typed receipt

the author and evaluator must be separate controlled identities

jurisdiction, entity, activity, data class, version, or effective-date applicability differs
professional authority or licensing is required

blocks.atomic_scope_statement: Governance-only control for preserving typed owner intent and routing true authority questions; it does not decide Product content, execute requested work, or accept its own candidate.

preserve the exact intent record and provenance without rewriting its meaning

return NOT_APPLICABLE when no owner-intent condition is present
route a true authority question to the declared authority owner
forbidden_decisions: accept or admit any candidate
convert chat, preference, or suggestion into authority
direct protected Memory internals
execute, publish, deploy, migrate, or write Product
infer missing owner identity, scope, or authority
resolve jurisdictional applicability without typed evidence
self-accept its own candidate
composition_rules: accept no owner intent until independent authority confirms the authority binding
compose only with typed context, source lock, and explicit custody
preserve unrelated work when a dependent authority action is UNKNOWN

map a typed requirement to the exact locked edition
return NOT_APPLICABLE when the external overlay proves the standard is irrelevant
return UNKNOWN when applicability or evidence is incomplete
forbidden_decisions: activate, deploy, publish, or self-accept
automated certification
broaden into a different standard
claim another edition or publisher
infer jurisdiction/entity/activity/data applicability
legal advice
composition_rules: UNKNOWN closes only the dependent requirement mapping
evaluate applicability only in the external overlay
new edition, material erratum, or gate correction creates a new block version
reuse exact ID/version/hash rather than copying requirements
